integrity: Analytical derivation based on an exact stationary random-affine recursion and a martingale-array limit; finite calculations reproduced from the included program. Publication priority subject to unindexed prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Theorem for fixed finite group size on the whole line with positive harmonic confinement and homogeneous exogenous Poisson reset clocks; no absorbing first-passage conclusion, growing-group universality, rare-event tail or quantitative convergence rate. Numerical checks support but do not replace the proof.
title: Gaussian stationary fluctuations in rightmost-reset Ornstein–Uhlenbeck groups
